The no-knead overnight treatment makes for amazing pizza crust, too. The dough recipe is also very similar.

400g bread flour.
260g water.
40g olive oil.
4g salt.
About 2tsp dry yeast.

Mix the dry ingredients, and add in the liquid, mixing only until the dough comes together raggedly. Then fridge it. 24 hours fridged is good, you can push it longer, too. I have left dough 48h in the fridge without issue.

Bring it out well in advance of when you want to bake, because the dough needs to warm up before the yeast can be active. Give the dough a few folds to knead in any surface dry spots. Let sit until it has about doubled in size before shaping the loaf for its second rise.

I baked this at 450F for 35 minutes but I have a baking stone to speed things up. Still, a high temperature will give you better oven spring.
